title: End of the world dream
content: All my life since I was a kid, roughly every 3-4 months, I’ll have a dream about the of the world. In each the location is different, but the events unfold the exact same way. 1) It’s late afternoon/early evening and I’m outside (always outside). Sky begins to get cloudy with storm clouds. 2) There are mountains in the distance, and liquid-like black clouds much darker than the first storm clouds, almost like ink, begin to swirl out from behind them, filling the sky. 3) As the liquid ink clouds move closer, tornados form from them and drop to the ground. 4) By this point, the clouds are so dark and think, it’s almost nighttime. 5) The tornados keep moving closer and the ground begins to crack open, with blindingly bright molten lava spewing from the cracks.
